Term Life Insurance (Pure Protection)

Maximum financial security for your family at the lowest possible cost.

1. What is Term Life Insurance?

Term insurance is the purest form of life insurance. You pay a small annual premium to secure a large payout (Sum Assured) for your nominee if you pass away during the policy term. Unlike traditional investment policies, term plans do not have maturity payouts if you survive the term, keeping premiums extremely affordable.

2. How Much Cover Do You Need?

The recommended cover amount is 10x to 15x your annual income plus any unpaid liabilities (home loans, car loans, personal debts).

Quick Formula:
Total Cover = (Annual Income × 12) + Total Outstanding Loans - Existing Assets

3. Essential Riders to Add

  • Accidental Death Benefit: Provides an additional payout if death occurs due to an accident.
  • Critical Illness Rider: Provides a lump-sum payout upon diagnosis of major illnesses like cancer or heart attack.
  • Waiver of Premium: Waives future premiums if you suffer permanent disability.
